name: embedded-assets
body: Embedded assets: `go:embed` bundle of reveal.js, templates, the `default` theme (EY look, CSS tokens), fonts, logos, starter deck, page shells. reveal.js is vendored at `internal/assets/reveal/`, copied from the 6.0.2 release package's `dist/` and committed there with its `LICENSE`; the minimal vendored set is `dist/reveal.js`, `dist/reveal.css`, `dist/reset.css`, `dist/plugin/notes.js` and `LICENSE`.
